doc: An editor module's variable (agents/start env, a name the settings put on drgnx-agents-start-env-names) reaches the session's agent again when a restarted hub resumes it: the hub keeps the start's env with the session. The profile's command is a shell that writes the variable, then a line saying it started, before it runs the mock ACP agent; the second start's line is the handshake before the check (no deadline decides it).

text: (drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-start-env-names ("DRGNX_MODULE_ENDPOINT")) (drgnx-agents-profiles (("mock-env" :provider claude :command ("/bin/sh" "-c" "(printenv DRGNX_MODULE_ENDPOINT || echo unset) >> $ROOT/env.txt; echo started >> $ROOT/env.txt; exec $MOCK acp --as claude --log $ROOT/acp.log")))))
